chunks: And then what they were promised comes upon them,

key_terms.يُوعَدُونَ: They were promised (passive verb referring to divine warnings or punishment)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when 'what they were promised' comes upon them in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who rejected the prophets, serving as a historical confirmation of the warnings given to the Quraysh and earlier nations. It highlights the transition from prophetic warning to actualized consequence, reinforcing the concept of *Haqq al-Yaqin* (certainty of truth) for the faithful.
